name: Cullen Roche
zh_summary: @cullenroche：長期國債是唯一能提供實質收益並在崩盤時傾向上漲的資產，但主要只在通縮或增長恐慌（如2008年）時有效，且多數時間實質價值在流失。價外認沽期權是真正的崩盤保險，但持有有成本。長存續期資產中的「安全收益」近乎神話；派息必需消費品最接近，而分派收益和緩衝收益基金多屬行銷噱頭。
en_summary: @cullenroche: long Treasuries are the only asset paying real income that tends to rally in a crash, but mainly in deflationary or growth scares like 2008, and they bleed in real terms most of the time. OTM puts are true crash insurance but cost money to hold. Safe income in long duration assets is a myth; dividend paying consumer staples come closest, while distribution yield and buffered income funds are mostly marketing.
ko_summary: @cullenroche: 장기 국채는 실질 소득을 주면서 폭락 때 오르는 유일한 자산이지만 2008년 같은 디플레이션이나 성장 공포에서만 주로 통하고 대부분 실질 가치가 깎인다. 외가격 풋은 진짜 폭락 보험이지만 보유 비용이 든다. 장기 듀레이션 자산의 안전한 소득은 환상에 가깝고, 배당 필수소비재가 가장 가깝다. 분배수익률 펀드와 버퍼형 인컴 상품은 대부분 마케팅이다.
text:
Tough question. Income with crash hedging but not stocks, credit or MF? Long Treasuries are the only thing that pays you real income and tends to rally in a crash. The catch is they only work in a deflationary or growth scare like 2008. That's the plain vanilla tail hedge with income, but long bonds are terrible long duration assets to hold because they bleed in real terms most of the time. 

OTM puts are true crash insurance in any environment, but they cost you money to wait. 

Frankly, I think the idea of "safe" income in a long duration asset is a bit like turning water into wine. Lots of products claim to provide it, but there are huge trade-offs in the long run so I'd personally treat income as safe income and long duration hedgers as something different. Dividend paying consumer staples might be as close as you can get to the holy grail of equity+income (but even those are paying out of tax efficient capital). These popular distribution yield funds and all the income buffered stuff are good marketing materials, but mostly counterproductive compared to something like home grown dividend strategies....

Either way, gold will likely outperform all else.

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: $NBIS 以 8.1 倍承諾 ARR 交易，相比 $IREN 的 5.1 倍和 $CRWV 的 2.5 倍，儘管 CoreWeave 有約 350 億美元承諾，而 Nebius 約 100 億美元、IREN 約 40 億美元。Nebius 僅有約 250 MW 活躍，對比 3.5 GW 合約，其中約 75% 未來產能位於自有場地，意味著其大部分潛在增長仍在前方。Nebius 每 MW 產生約 1300 萬美元收入，相比 CoreWeave 的約 1100 萬美元，隨著推理軟件擴張，這有助解釋溢價，同時 CoreWeave 債務更重。
en_summary: $NBIS trades at 8.1x committed ARR versus 5.1x for $IREN and 2.5x for $CRWV even though CoreWeave has ~$35B committed compared with Nebius at ~$10B and IREN at ~$4B. Nebius has only ~250 MW active against 3.5 GW contracted with ~75% of that future capacity on owned sites meaning most of its potential growth is still ahead. Nebius also generates ~$13M in revenue per MW versus ~$11M for CoreWeave as inference software expands helping explain the premium alongside CoreWeave’s heavier debt.
ko_summary: $NBIS는 약속된 ARR의 8.1배로 거래되며, $IREN의 5.1배, $CRWV의 2.5배와 비교된다. CoreWeave는 약 350억 달러 약속, Nebius 약 100억 달러, IREN 약 40억 달러다. Nebius는 활성 약 250 MW에 대해 3.5 GW 계약이 있으며, 그 미래 용량의 약 75%가 소유 부지에 있어 잠재적 성장의 대부분이 아직 앞에 있다. Nebius는 MW당 약 1300만 달러 수익을 창출하며 CoreWeave의 약 1100만 달러와 비교되며, 추론 소프트웨어 확장으로 프리미엄을 설명하고 CoreWeave의 더 무거운 부채와 함께한다.

text:
John, you are almost always an admirably clear thinker. But you endorse a common fallacy when you make this argument: "Higher rates hurt supply-side solutions in housing, energy, autos, and other capital intensive industries"

The issue is that much more demand is reduced before any supply is reduced. For example, higher interest rates might cut $100 of upfront spending and result in $5/yr less in supply starting 3 years from now. That is deflationary.

You can also think of your argument in reverse. If the government made a big increase in infrastructure investment or businesses suddenly decided to invest more in autos we would expect that to put upward pressure on inflation not downward pressure.

text:
PAUL TUDOR JONES TODAY:

- "2027 is going to be a very challenging year for the market."

- "Right now feels exactly like 1999, for me it’s just so clear that we’re on this path that could be great short term but may not be so great long term. I forget that so many people haven’t lived this."

- “I’ll be short the whole year. There just — there’s little value. You had all this issuance, all these IPOs in ’98 and ’99, and really 2000, 2001, 2002. Those were the easiest years to be short because you kept having these unlocks that just kept adding supply to the market.”

PTJ was one of the few investors that began actively shorting the Nasdaq Composite Index in 1999. The question becomes...is he right that we are in 1999, or is it more like 1997? Even Jensen has said that this will all eventually become a bubble but he thinks we have many years before we get there. 

I think his comments today are creating more pressure on the semis as many people are trying to navigate 2027 positioning and if the core names in the AI trade are the ones to continue betting on going into next year.

Applied is also expanding into the $KLAC inspection market with eBeam expected to reach $2B this year, while doubling R&D and manufacturing capacity for complex AI chips, HBM and advanced packaging.
ko_summary: @StockSavvyShay는 $AMAT이 2030년까지 매출총이익률 54%, 영업이익률 40%를 목표로 하며 FCF의 약 90%를 주주에게 환원할 계획이라고 했다. 서비스 매출은 120억 달러를 넘을 전망이며, $KLAC 검사 시장으로 eBeam 사업을 확장해 올해 20억 달러에 이를 수 있고 AI 칩·HBM·첨단 패키징을 위해 R&D와 생산능력을 두 배로 늘린다고 했다.
text:
$AMAT is targeting 54% gross margins and 40% operating margins by 2030 while planning to return ~90% of FCF to shareholders.

A big part of that comes from service revenue expected to exceed $12B as chipmakers keep maintaining and upgrading existing equipment giving Applied more recurring revenue even when new equipment spending slows.

Applied is also expanding into $KLAC inspection market with its eBeam business expected to reach $2B this year while doubling R&D and manufacturing capacity to support really complex AI chips, HBM and advanced packaging.

ticker_notes.SNDK: 企業級SSD市佔率低，有追趕空間
ticker_notes.MU: 企業級SSD市佔率較高，數據中心佔NAND收入大

en_summary: Enterprise SSD revenue reached ~$38B in Q2 as AI agents need more fast storage to handle growing context, making SSDs an important part of AI infrastructure. $SNDK's 103% QoQ revenue jump is interesting because it holds only ~8% of enterprise SSDs versus 11% of overall NAND, leaving room to catch up. $MU is further ahead with ~19% enterprise SSD share versus 15% of NAND, and data center SSDs now account for over 2/3 of its NAND revenue as AI drives a richer storage mix.

zh_summary: 這是對金融機構如何破產的驚人誤解。它們破產不是因為資產變壞，而是因為融資變得不可能。當然，當融資市場不再信任資產時，融資就會變壞。它們可以盡可能延長和假裝。但如果資產支持票據市場不信任資產，這就幫不了它們。在這種情況下，信任消失的可能性非常高。
en_summary: This is a spectacular misunderstanding of how financial institutions go bankrupt. They go bankrupt not when the assets go bad but when their funding becomes impossible. Sure the funding goes bad when the funding market no longer trusts the assets. They can extend and pretend as long as they like. But it won't help them if say the asset backed paper market doesn't trust the assets. In this case there is a very high chance that trust has gone away.
ko_summary: 이것은 금융 기관이 어떻게 파산하는지에 대한 놀라운 오해다. 자산이 나빠질 때가 아니라 자금 조달이 불가능해질 때 파산한다. 물론 자금 시장이 더 이상 자산을 신뢰하지 않을 때 자금 조달이 나빠진다. 그들은 원하는 만큼 연장하고 가장할 수 있다. 하지만 자산 담보 어음 시장이 자산을 신뢰하지 않으면 도움이 되지 않는다. 이 경우 신뢰가 사라진 가능성이 매우 높다.

ticker_notes.CIFR: 已簽約約 700 MW，另有約 4.4 GW 管道，其中約 4 GW 目標 20

zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 表示，$CIFR 已簽約約 700 MW 用於 AI 和高效能運算，另有約 4.4 GW 的電力管道，是目前簽約量的 6 倍以上。如果能將這些電力轉化為長期 AI 租約，Cipher 未來數年有潛在增長空間，其中約 4 GW 管道目標為 2028 年及以後。
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay says $CIFR already has about 700 MW contracted for AI and HPC, with another about 4.4 GW in its power pipeline, more than 6x what is signed today. Cipher has years of potential growth ahead if it can convert that power into long-term AI leases, with about 4 GW of the pipeline targeted for 2028 and beyond.
ko_summary: @StockSavvyShay는 $CIFR이 AI와 HPC용으로 이미 약 700MW를 계약했으며, 전력 파이프라인에 약 4.4GW가 더 있어 현재 계약량의 6배 이상이라고 밝혔다. 이 전력을 장기 AI 임대로 전환할 수 있다면 Cipher는 수년간 성장 잠재력이 있으며, 파이프라인 중 약 4GW가 2028년 이후를 목표로 한다.
text:
$CIFR already has ~700 MW contracted for AI and HPC with another ~4.4 GW in its power pipeline which is more than 6x what it has signed today.

Cipher has years of potential growth ahead if it can keep turning that power into long term AI leases with ~4 GW of its pipeline targeted for 2028 and beyond.
